Scenario fixture: scrollable-region-focusable

Each target element has a stable id of the form srf_case_NN. jsdom does not perform layout, so these cases are driven entirely by declared CSS overflow, not actual measured scroll overflow.

A. CANTTELL — scrollable overflow, not reachable by keyboard

01 — CANTTELL: overflow-y:auto, no focusable descendant, not itself focusable
Plain long text content with no interactive children at all.
02 — CANTTELL: overflow-x:scroll, no focusable descendant, not itself focusable
a very long line of preformatted text that would overflow horizontally

B. Not flagged

03 — NEUTRAL: scrollable overflow but itself has tabindex="0"
Long content, but the region itself is focusable.
04 — NEUTRAL: scrollable overflow but contains a focusable descendant
Long content with a link inside it.
05 — NEUTRAL: not scrollable (overflow:visible)
Plain content, no declared scroll overflow.

End of fixture.
